title: Fix 294
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cli-061 already says a gate's summary names its change as Change: <id> - <title> (<state>) with no em dash; only a test, its case and a changelog fragment are added, and src/gates.rs is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: A test opens a gate on a session whose native change is recorded and asserts that chough gate list prints the summary line Change: <id> - <title> (<state>) and that the summary holds no em dash; it fails when the em dash returns to src/gates.rs. src/gates.rs is unchanged.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes, and a delta is frozen at approval (this change has none). No other lesson or principle constrains it.
